name: sci-hub-opener
description: Firefox extension that opens the PDF of a scientific article in Sci-Hub.

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename sci-hub-opener.xpi --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test
scripts.lint: web-ext lint --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test
scripts.start: web-ext run --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json test
